name: Earrings
overview: Scripture references earrings primarily as valuable items of gold used for adornment and offerings, as seen when a man gives a golden earring as a gift (Genesis 24:22) and when the Israelites bring earrings as part of their offerings to the LORD (Exodus 35:22; Numbers 31:50). Earrings also appear in contexts of idolatry, with Jacob collecting earrings associated with foreign gods to remove them from his household (Genesis 35:4), and Aaron instructing the removal of golden earrings from the people to prevent idolatrous practices (Exodus 32:2). While the Bible records men and women wearing earrings, it does not explicitly prescribe or forbid the practice, but it does caution against marking the body in ways that dishonor God (Leviticus 19:28).
